theme: An open Sunday with the booking clock ticking.

needsAttention.title: December trip, book by Oct 15
needsAttention.detail: Three weeks over the holidays for six is the thinnest inventory of the year. Pick the domestic default or refundable-international and lock a shortlist before the 15th.
